messages:
maria.k: Hey all — first-week oncall newbie here. I9m scheduled to shadow next Thur 2026-04-01 10:00-14:00. Quick qs: who to ask for a swap if something comes up, and where9s the short page-handling runbook?

jamal: Welcome Maria! :wave: Ping @olivia_ops for swaps. If she9s out, DM me. Runbook link (Confluence) is https://confluence.redwood.ai/oncall/runbooks/page-handling — you9ll need SSO.

maria.k: SSO still pending (submitted yesterday). Should I ask IT or someone here?

olivia_ops: I can grant a temporary viewer link if you post your work email here. Also do this pre-shift checklist: - confirm PagerDuty routing - skim the Page Handling runbook - run `./scripts/runbook-check.sh` locally - join #eng-oncall 15m early - add emergency contact in PagerDuty

sam_sre: A couple of operational tips: 1) DB connection spikes live under the "DB spikes" section in the runbook. 2) Model fallback steps are a short snippet you can paste to incident channels: check model pool health, route to fallback, notify #eng-runtime.

maria.k: Thanks. Can someone add a pairing mentor to the calendar? I was assigned but no pairing person listed.

olivia_ops: Added @jamal as your mentor and sent calendar invite.

deploy-bot: Notice: Canary rollout scheduled 2026-04-01 09:30 UTC for inference-runtime v2.3.1 — minor latency fluctuations possible.

maria.k: Should I mute pages during the canary?

jamal: Don9t mute. Canary noise is a good learning opportunity. If it9s noisy but non-actionable mark as noisy; if actionable follow the runbook and escalate to me or Olivia.

olivia_ops: Bookmark runbook anchors: DB spikes, Model fallback, Escalation matrix. Fastest way to reach the section you need.

maria.k: Any short incident summary template to practice?

sam_sre: Use this minimal template: Summary: <1-line> Impact: <who/how many> Timeline: <HH:MM bullets> Root cause (tentative): <one line> Actions taken: <bullets> Next steps: <bullets> Owner: <your name>

maria.k: Perfect. Posting my email via DM to Olivia now. Will confirm when SSO is live and mark ready for shadow. :thumbsup:

jamal: Great. If you want to rehearse an incident during shadow, we can trigger a harmless synthetic alert and walk through the steps. See you on shift! :rocket:
